codes.ACCRUAL_NOT_RUN: Charges for {period} have not been posted yet
codes.PERIOD_NOT_CLOSED: Previous month’s finance period can be closed

units.title: Define units
units.body: Create blocks and unit numbers to set up the property structure.

occupancy.title: Assign owners / tenants
occupancy.body: Assign an owner or tenant to each unit — billing and collection depend on this.

definitions.title: Create charge types
definitions.body: Define monthly dues and shared expense charge types.

cashboxes.title: Add a cashbox
cashboxes.body: Set up cash or bank accounts to record collections.

accrual.title: Post first billing
accrual.body: Generate and post billing so it appears on owner accounts.

help.calculationMode: How the charge is calculated: fixed amount, area, share ratio, or bill allocation.
help.shareRatio: The total amount is split across units by land share ratio.
help.draftAccrual: Draft billing is not posted to owners yet; post it to create debt.
help.postAccrual: Posted billing creates debt on owner accounts and enables collection.
help.accountKind: Owner/tenant, supplier, or staff — who the account is linked to.
help.lateFeeTypes: Due penalty, supplier invoice penalty, and legal interest are separate.

sections.fields: What do the form fields mean?
sections.fieldsEmpty: No dedicated form fields for this topic; use the lists and filters on the related screen.
sections.buttonsEmpty: No dedicated button list; use the main actions on the related screen.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started from zero
gettingStarted.summary: If you are moving from Excel or paper, set up the building structure first, then charge types and a cashbox; then bill and collect. Keep that order.
gettingStarted.where: Left menu → Overview (setup guide and monthly tasks start here). Glossary: Left menu → Glossary.
gettingStarted.screen:
When Overview opens, Setup guide or Recommended settings appear at the top.
Below: this month’s tasks and month-end workflow.
At the bottom: quick actions — Record collection, Bill, Record expense.
howTo: Select your property (if you manage several, use Apartments in the menu).
On Overview, if Recommended settings appear, apply them to create a default block/cashbox.
Complete Setup guide left to right: Blocks → Units → Owner/tenant assignment → Charge type → Cashbox → First billing.
On each step use Complete or Open page, fill required fields, and save.
Create the first billing as a draft, post it, then record payments under Collections & debt list.
When stuck, How to use? on the page header jumps to the matching glossary topic.

buttons.name: Apply recommended settings
buttons.desc: Creates suggested basics (block, cashbox) so you do less manual setup.

buttons.name: Complete
buttons.desc: Marks a setup-guide step done (the real work happens on the linked page).

buttons.name: How to use?
buttons.desc: Opens this glossary for the current module with menus, forms, and buttons explained.

tips: Without units and owners, billing and collections will not work.
For PROPERTY_MANAGER, Simple view / Full view in the header changes menu density.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.summary: Home screen for the property: debt, cash, overdue units; setup, monthly tasks, and quick actions start here.
dashboard.screen:
Top: Overview title + How to use?
Middle: Setup guide / monthly tasks / month-end workflow cards.
KPI tiles: Total receivable, Billing this month, Cash balance, Overdue units, Staff ledger.
Bottom: Quick actions and top debtors / recent movements.
howTo: Open Overview each time and check warnings.
Follow monthly tasks or month-end workflow with Go.
For daily work use Record collection or Bill under Quick actions.
Use top debtors to spot problem units; open debt status or collections as needed.

buttons.name: Record collection
buttons.desc: Opens Collections & debt list to record a payment.

buttons.name: Bill
buttons.desc: Opens billing to create monthly charges.

buttons.name: Record expense
buttons.desc: Opens Income & expense entries.

buttons.name: Go to reports
buttons.desc: Opens the report hub (depends on role and menu profile).

buttons.name: Go (task / workflow)
buttons.desc: Navigates to the screen for that listed task.

tips: KPIs are summaries; open the related menu for detail.
Incomplete setup can block billing — read the alerts.

setup.title: Property setup / definitions
setup.summary: Hub for blocks, units, owners, charge types, and cashboxes.
setup.where: Left menu → Apartment definitions. The same steps also live under units, charge types, cashbox; Overview setup guide lists them all.
setup.screen:
Title: Apartment definitions.
Setup steps: Blocks, Units, Owner/tenant assignments, Charge types, Cash & bank, First billing, optional Staff ledger.
Shortcuts: Units, Charge types, Cashbox, Blocks — each with Open page.
howTo: Open the first incomplete setup step or use Open page.
If there is no block, add one under Blocks (name required).
Add units, then assign owners/tenants.
Define at least one monthly dues charge type.
Create a cash or bank cashbox (selected when collecting).
On First billing, create a draft run and post it.

fields.name: Block / unit name fields
fields.desc: Building structure labels shown on debt and collection rows.

fields.name: Owner / tenant assignment
fields.desc: Links who pays for the unit; missing assignment can block billing/collection.

buttons.name: Complete
buttons.desc: Marks the guide step finished.

buttons.name: Open page
buttons.desc: Goes to the related definition screen.

tips: Order matters: structure → charge type → cashbox → billing → collection.
Staff ledger is optional on day one.

units.title: Units, members, and assignments
units.summary: Building structure: blocks, units, members (owners/tenants), and who occupies which unit.
units.where: Left menu → Apartment definitions / structure → Units (or Blocks, Members, Assignments).
units.screen:
Property detail tabs: Blocks, Units, Members, Assignments, Utilities.
Unit list rows are properties; assignment links a member.
howTo: Add a block first (even for a single-block building).
Add units with numbers/names.
Create owner or tenant members.
Assign the person to the unit; without this, ledger and collection flows are incomplete.
Add meters later under utilities if you allocate by consumption.

fields.name: Unit name
fields.desc: Identity shown on lists and debt lines (e.g. A-12).

fields.name: Member details
fields.desc: Name and contact used for collections and notices.

fields.name: Assignment type (owner / tenant)
fields.desc: Who is responsible for charges and payments.

buttons.name: Add / Save
buttons.desc: Creates or updates block, unit, member, or assignment.

buttons.name: Edit
buttons.desc: Updates an existing record.

tips: Do not leave units empty; allocation will be incomplete.
When tenants change, update the assignment so the wrong person is not billed.

dues.title: Charge types
dues.summary: Definitions of billable items (monthly dues, water/heat allocation, etc.). Billing runs use these groups.
dues.where: Left menu → Apartment definitions → Charge types. Or finance page Definitions → Charge types. Path: …/dues?tab=definitions
dues.screen:
Page title is often Billing groups.
Top: Add standard group and Supplier late-fee group.
Rows: Edit, enable/disable job; badges for monthly job and supplier penalty.
3-step wizard: name → calculation mode → amount/review.
howTo: Click Add standard group.
Enter a group name (e.g. Monthly dues).
Choose a calculation mode; Fixed amount is easiest for beginners.
Continue to the amount step and enter Monthly amount.
Optionally enable Monthly automatic billing (job); you can still bill manually.
Save with Add standard group / Save changes.
Then bill that group under Bill dues / expenses.

fields.name: Calculation mode
fields.desc: Fixed; per m²; share allocation; invoice/meter share; unit-price meter; supplier late fee.

fields.name: Monthly amount / m² price / total to allocate
fields.desc: Required amount fields depending on mode.

fields.name: Meter type
fields.desc: For meter modes: hot water, cold water, heating, gas.

fields.name: Monthly automatic billing (job)
fields.desc: Schedules periodic billing; still review and post.

buttons.name: Add standard group
buttons.desc: Opens the wizard or finishes saving.

buttons.name: Next / Back
buttons.desc: Moves between wizard steps.

buttons.name: Edit
buttons.desc: Changes an existing group.

buttons.name: Enable / disable job
buttons.desc: Turns monthly automatic billing on or off.

tips: Start with one fixed monthly dues group; add advanced modes later.
Supplier late-fee groups are not the same as owner dues late penalties.

cashbox.title: Cash & bank
cashbox.summary: Cash drawer or bank account where collections are deposited. Without a cashbox, the collection form is blocked.
cashbox.where: Left menu → Apartment definitions → Cash & bank. Path: …/dues?tab=cashboxes. Setup step: Cash & bank.
cashbox.screen:
Cashbox list and add form.
On collections, the Cashbox field uses these records.
howTo: Open Cash & bank.
Add at least one cashbox (e.g. Cash or Bank — …).
Save; Overview cash balance uses these accounts.
When collecting, pick the cashbox on the payment form.

fields.name: Cashbox name
fields.desc: Option label on the collection form.

fields.name: Type (cash / bank)
fields.desc: Where money sits; matters for reports and reconciliation.

buttons.name: Add cashbox / Save
buttons.desc: Creates a new cashbox.

tips: You can use multiple cashboxes; pick the right one each time.
Recommended settings may create a default cashbox.

accrual.title: Bill dues / expenses
accrual.summary: Allocate a charge group to units for a year/month. Create a draft first, then post.
accrual.where: Left menu → Daily work → Bill dues / expenses. Top tabs: Billing. Path: …/dues?tab=accrual.
accrual.screen:
Title often Member billing.
Bill button opens a drawer.
Billing periods card: period tabs, Draft / Posted badge, unit-member-amount table.
Alerts list setup blockers.
howTo: Ensure charge type, units, and assignments are ready (fix alerts first).
Click Bill.
Select group, year, and month.
For invoice/meter modes fill total amount or consumption.
Submit Bill to create a draft; review unit lines.
If correct, Post billing → confirm with Post.
After posting, collect under Collections & debt list.

fields.name: Invoice total / consumption
fields.desc: Required for share or meter groups.

fields.name: Allocation method / supplier reference
fields.desc: Used for supplier late-fee style groups.

buttons.name: Bill
buttons.desc: Creates a draft period; does not yet hit owner ledgers.

buttons.name: Post billing
buttons.desc: Writes the draft to owner accounts; unlocks collections.

buttons.name: Undo posting
buttons.desc: Reverses posting if no payments/late fees exist.

buttons.name: Accrue missing units
buttons.desc: Completes posted runs that missed units.

tips: Learn draft vs posting (see topics below).
Fix amounts in draft; undoing after posting is harder.

draftAccrual.title: Draft billing
draftAccrual.summary: Period created by Bill that is not yet on owner ledgers. Use it to review and correct.
draftAccrual.where: Bill dues / expenses → period card with Draft badge.
draftAccrual.screen:
Period tab badge: Draft.
Lines are visible but not collectible yet.
Post action is available.
howTo: Select the draft period after billing.
Check each unit amount.
Fix wrong group/month before posting.
When ready, go to posting.

buttons.name: Post billing
buttons.desc: Turns the draft into real debt.

tips: Draft = preview. Owners only see debt after posting.

postAccrual.title: Posting
postAccrual.summary: Writing draft billing onto owner ledger accounts. Collections become possible afterward.
postAccrual.where: Bill dues / expenses → selected draft → Post billing. Confirm dialog: Confirm posting.
postAccrual.screen:
Confirm dialog with summary + Cancel / Post.
After success badge becomes Posted.
Late-fee runs are posted separately when applied.
howTo: Final-check draft lines.
Click Post billing.
Read the summary and confirm Post (or Cancel).
Verify debts appear under Collections & debt list.

buttons.name: Post
buttons.desc: Confirms; debts hit ledgers.

buttons.name: Cancel
buttons.desc: Closes the dialog; draft remains.

buttons.name: Undo posting
buttons.desc: Reverses if no collection or late fee exists on the run.

tips: You cannot collect before posting.
Undo is not always available after payments.

register.title: Collections & debt list
register.summary: See open debt by unit and record payments. Formerly the period register; the page title may still say Period register.
register.where: Left menu → Daily work → Collections & debt list. Top tab: Collections. Path: …/dues?tab=register.
register.screen:
Filters: Year, Month, search, Block, Overdue only / Debtors only, Filter.
Table: Unit, Member, Period remaining, Total open debt; late-fee badge.
Payment form: Cashbox, Amount, Payment date, Document no.
Actions: Bulk collect, CSV/Excel/PDF export.
howTo: Set year/month and Filter.
Open the unit row or Record collection / unit — Collect.
Choose cashbox; enter amount (open-debt hint / auto-allocate may apply).
Set payment date and optional document no.
Submit Record collection.
For many rows: Bulk collect → select → Collect selected.

buttons.name: Record collection
buttons.desc: Saves a single payment.

buttons.name: Bulk collect / Collect selected
buttons.desc: Collects several units at once.

buttons.name: View detail / Open debts / Account statement
buttons.desc: Drills into unit or member detail.

buttons.name: Download CSV / Excel / PDF
buttons.desc: Exports the list.

tips: Missing cashbox or assignment blocks payment — read the on-screen message.
The period must be posted before you can collect.

collection.title: Collection (payment entry)
collection.summary: Recording money received from an owner/tenant. Done from Collections & debt list.
collection.where: Payment form or bulk collect inside Collections & debt list. Overview → Record collection.
collection.screen:
Drawer/row form: Cashbox, Amount, Payment date, Document no + Record collection.
On success debt falls and cashbox balance rises.
howTo: Pick the correct unit and period.
Enter cashbox and amount, then Record collection.
Partial payments leave remaining debt on the list.
Use Document no for receipts and audit trails.

fields.name: Cashbox / Amount / Payment date / Document no
fields.desc: Core payment fields (see Collections & debt list).

buttons.name: Record collection
buttons.desc: Saves the payment and updates balances.

tips: Wrong cashbox skews reports — check before saving.

account.title: Owner / tenant accounts (ledger)
account.summary: Finance account linked to an owner, tenant, supplier, or staff member. Debt and collections track through these accounts.
account.where: Left menu → Apartment definitions → Owner / tenant accounts. Path: …/dues?tab=accounts. Staff: Staff accounts.
account.screen:
Title: Ledger accounts.
Table: code, name, balance.
Drawer: Add account — code, name, type, member link.
howTo: Most owner accounts are created with occupancy; open the list to check balances.
Add supplier/general accounts when needed.
Choose type: Owner/tenant, Supplier, Staff, or General.
Link a member when applicable, or None.
Use Staff accounts for janitor/payroll-style ledgers.

fields.name: Member link
fields.desc: Ties the account to a person record.

buttons.name: Add account
buttons.desc: Creates a new ledger account.

buttons.name: Save
buttons.desc: Saves the form.

tips: Daily work often needs only the collections screen.
Use statements / debt list to understand balances.

expenses.title: Income & expense entries
expenses.summary: Cash movements for property expenses and income slips. Separate from dues billing.
expenses.where: Left menu → Daily work → Income & expense entries. Top tab: Income & expense. Path: …/dues?tab=expenses.
expenses.screen:
Entry list and new slip form.
Expense categories live under Definitions → Expense items.
Overview recent movements link here.
howTo: Open Income & expense entries.
Add an expense or income slip with amount, cashbox, category, and date.
Save; cashbox balance and reports update.
Predefine frequent categories under Expense items.

buttons.name: Record expense / Save
buttons.desc: Saves a new slip.

tips: To allocate a shared cost to units, usually use a charge type + billing; use this screen for one-off cash movements.

lateFee.title: Late penalty
lateFee.summary: Penalty when dues payments are late. Different from supplier invoice penalties and the legal-interest screen.
lateFee.where: Left menu → Daily work → Late penalty. Under Billing top tab. Path: …/dues?tab=lateFee.
lateFee.screen:
Decision guide separates dues late fee / supplier late fee / legal interest.
Policy card: mode, monthly rate, grace days, due day → Save policy.
Apply: Year/Month → Apply late fee for this month → post the resulting run.
howTo: Confirm the decision guide: you want dues late compensation here.
Choose how late fees apply: none, fixed monthly rate, or legal interest (CBRT).
For fixed rate enter Monthly rate (%); set grace days and due day.
Save policy.
Pick year/month and Apply late fee for this month.
Post the generated late-fee billing run.

fields.name: Monthly rate (%)
fields.desc: Percent when fixed rate is selected.

buttons.name: Save policy
buttons.desc: Stores the rules.

buttons.name: Apply late fee for this month
buttons.desc: Creates penalty lines for the period (then post).

buttons.name: Post late-fee billing
buttons.desc: Writes penalties to ledgers.

tips: Condo-law dues late fee ≠ supplier invoice surcharge.
Legal interest rates are managed under Legal interest at org level.

reports.title: Reports
reports.summary: Billing, collection, expense, cash, and annual income-expense outputs.
reports.where: Left menu → Reports. Path: …/reports. May be hidden in the daily profile; use Full view.
reports.screen:
Report hub with report types.
Filters: Year, Month, Block, (annual) Quarter.
Downloads: CSV, Excel, PDF, ZIP; some Export in background + queue Download.
Extras: operating plan, bank reconciliation, auditor templates (role-based).
howTo: Pick a report (e.g. Billing summary or Collections).
Set year, month, and optional block.
Download CSV / Excel / PDF.
For heavy packages use Export in background, then Download when ready.
Month-end workflow also has Download monthly report.

fields.name: Quarter
fields.desc: Period for annual income-expense style reports.

buttons.name: Download CSV / Excel / PDF / ZIP
buttons.desc: Downloads the file.

buttons.name: Export in background
buttons.desc: Queues a heavy export.

buttons.name: Save operating plan
buttons.desc: Stores operating-plan data on that panel.

tips: For board meetings, Billing summary and Collections are usually enough.
If Reports is missing, switch to Full view or check role permissions.
